Triage: lands in `domain:ui` (`packages/plugin-detail/README.md` — published library surface); rationale: class (a), the definitional case of the boundary now in the rule — 「示例照抄即失败是 (a)」. A reader copying the tab example renders the registry's `Unknown component type` panel (**OBJUI-001**). `Bug`.

⭐ **The trace is complete rather than inferred, which is what makes it gradeable without re-measuring**: `DetailTabs.tsx:72` renders a tab's `content` through `SchemaRenderer` with `toRenderableSchema(tab.content)` ⇒ `content.type` is an **SDUI node position judged by the component registry**; `index.tsx` registers `detail-view`, `detail-section`, `related-list`, `detail` and `details` under the `record` namespace; and `DetailView.tsx:1460` knows a tab **key** `activity`, ⛔ not a component **type**. Every link named, so the conclusion is read off the code.

`priority:p3`: one example, and the failure is **loud and self-identifying** — the reader gets a named error panel with a code, not a blank box. ⚠️ Contrast objectui#8284 (graded `p2` today), where the same class of mistake renders **nothing** with no signal at all. Loud beats silent by a grade.

⭐ **This card is one of the two `Blocked-by:` items on objectui#7896** (the other being objectui#8115, graded today), which is why it matters more than one README line: the widening that would make this whole class fail loudly is blocked until both close. ⇒ Grading them together at p3 keeps that chain coherent.

⚠️ **The acceptance fence is the operative instruction and ⛔ must not be skipped**: the seat that takes this decides *which* type the example should name — `record:activity` per the registry, or a different tab-content shape — **by reading `DetailTabs.tsx` and the registry, ⛔ not by guessing**. A plausible-looking substitution that is also unregistered reproduces the defect with a new spelling.

⛔ **No gate change in this card.** The widening is #7896's, and #7896 is blocked by this one — ⛔ do not invert that order by landing a gate here.

⭐ Same shape as the `line-chart` widget in `plugin-dashboard/README.md` that #7896 recorded and PR #7951 fixed on the docs side, plus objectui#7866 and #7440 — ⇒ **fourth known instance**, which is the argument for #7896's widening rather than for a fifth one-line fix.

Why nothing caught it, worth stating in the PR so the fix is not mistaken for coverage: `check:doc-types` does not walk `packages/NAME/README.md` (that is exactly #7896), and `check:doc-snippets` compiles the block but **its own header names schema-key validity as the question it does not answer**. ⇒ After this lands the example will be correct and still ungated until #7896 does.

⛔ This seat grades and routes only: not claimed, not dispatched, no code.

2. **⛔ The host probe cannot establish death here.** `get_session(session_018rzQyhLGC5iVs11V3TzRs5)` answers *not found* — but that instrument resolves only the **calling account's** sessions, so for a session under another GitHub identity *not found* means **out of scope, not dead**. | probe | reading on `origin/main` |
|---|---|

## ⛔⛔ THE CARD'S REGISTRY CENSUS IS INCOMPLETE — and the missing entry is probably your answer

The card says `index.tsx` registers *"`detail-view`, `detail-section`, `related-list`, `detail`, and `details` under the `record` namespace"*, and that `DetailView.tsx:1460` knows a tab **key** `activity`, ⛔ *"not a component type"*.

**There is more, and one of them is `activity`.** Read today:

```
:300 register('detail-view', …)      :352 register('detail-section', …)
:396 register('related-list', …)     :414 register('detail', …)
:444 register('details', …)          :560 register('related_list', …)
:624 register('highlights', …)       :673 register('activity', RecordActivityRenderer, …)
```

⇒ `activity` **is** a registered component type. The card's claim that it is only a tab key is **false as written**, and the card's own acceptance line was already reaching for this before it was truncated. ⚠️ ⛔ I am **not** telling you the answer is `record:activity` — I have not checked that `RecordActivityRenderer` is the right thing to put in a *detail tab's* `content`, nor what data shape it expects. **Read it and decide**, and if it is wrong for this position, say so and name what is right.

## Scope

Make the README example name a component type that is **registered on `main`**, so a reader copying it gets a render instead of the `OBJUI-001` *Unknown component type* panel.

⛔ **Docs only.** If you find yourself editing `index.tsx`, `DetailTabs.tsx` or `DetailView.tsx`, **stop and report** — registering a new type is a different card with a different cost.

## ⚠️ This card is a link in a chain — two things follow it

Triage: this is **one of the two `Blocked-by:` items on objectui#7896** (the other is objectui#8115), and *"the widening that would make this whole class fail loudly is blocked until both close."* And objectui#8115 waits on **this** landing specifically. ⇒ ⛔ do not widen scope to "fix the class"; landing this one link is what releases the chain.

## ⛔ Hard constraints

- ⛔ **One example.** The census found 26 unregistered `type` literals across 39 package READMEs; **this is the one real defect** and the other 25 are non-component vocabularies proposed as `DOC_TYPE_EXEMPTIONS`. ⛔ Do not sweep them.
- ⛔ **Do not add a gate.** `check:doc-types` not walking `packages/NAME/README.md` is objectui#7896's subject, not yours.
- ⛔ objectui `AGENTS.md:316`: never `git push --force` or `--force-with-lease`, never push to `main`. Absolute, and ⛔ **not** tiered by seat.

## Clause-②: `no` — a README example. ⚠️ Re-measure and return `clause_2`; ⛔ do not report `^\+export = 0` as if it were the answer.

## The pin

⚠️ Documentation-only, so be honest about what is pinnable — the sibling card objectui#7998 answered this well an hour ago and it is worth copying the *method*: if a gate in this repo can compile or validate the block, wire it and say what it holds; if none can, **say so plainly** and make the corrected example quote something the registry actually declares, so the next drift is a diff. ⛔ Do not invent a test that asserts a string it also wrote.

## Serial constraints cleared

`packages/plugin-detail/README.md`. ⚠️ **Named rather than assumed**: PR objectui#9811 (card objectui#7998) also edits this exact file and is **in the merge queue** as I write — green, `clean`, awaiting its slot. ⛔ **Branch from `main` AFTER it lands**, or merge `main` again once it does; the two edits are in different sections but the file is the same, and the queue arbitrates only what it can see. ⛔ Never hand-order around it. My other in-flight card is objectui#8078 (`plugin-chatbot`) — no overlap.

## Return

The registry reading that picked your replacement type and why it is right for a **tab's `content`** position, what you could and could not pin, the `clause_2` field, and any premise of mine you falsified. ⭐ The card's registry census was already one. **A clean stop is a full success.**
